worked: Full-price demand: LLY grew +64% vs Sept at only 6% markdown, and LY held 0–10% markdown through Singles yet still did +122% on 11.11 (41K/day vs 35K LLY).
YF was the biggest Beauty day of LY: 137K/day (+641% vs Sept, 80K LLY) at 70% markdown with impressions +885%; Pre YF and YF Post nearly doubled vs LLY (94K and 80K vs 52K and 42K per day).
missed: BF Week at 73% markdown gave 42.5K/day vs 34K LLY at 13%: conversion rose, but ASP halved, so the extra markdown bought little GMV.
Dec MS: impressions +191% vs Sept but UCR fell to 0.8% and GMV stayed only +47%, so the visibility was wasted at full price.
Sept 2026 UCR is 1.07% vs 1.68% LY (ASP 195 vs 168): conversion is the risk going in.
do: Keep full price through Oct and Singles; put the depth into Pre YF + YF + YF Post only.
Don't open deep markdown for the whole BF Week; fix conversion (hero shades in stock, price vs other retailers) before buying impressions.

worked: A deep-discount brand: about 48–53% markdown on every event in both years, with UCR of 4–5% on event days.
LY's Singles extension: Post Singles 67K/day (+66% vs LLY) and the BAU week after Singles 74K/day vs 15.5K LLY at 57% markdown. Carrying the deal into the following week worked.
missed: Pre Singles LY: 39K/day vs 66.5K LLY (−42%) even with impressions +199% (UCR 3.2% vs 4.6%). The early-Singles offer didn't convert.
YF: 74.5K/day vs 91K LLY (−18%) at the same 50% markdown and 5× impressions. Conversion fell from 5.3% to 4.3%.
Sept 2026 is 7.9K/day vs 17.5K LY (−55%), with UCR 1.74% vs 2.71%. The brand is structurally down coming into OND.
do: Lock 50%+ for Pre Singles → 11.11 → the week after (LY's extension was the best part).
Find out why Sept 2026 halved (stock, listings, price) before OND, otherwise impressions won't convert.

worked: LLY was the model: +120% vs Sept with only +50% impressions at 36% markdown (organic pull). Singles ran 3 strong days (68K / 126K / 58K per day).
LY's YF and YF Post held up: 124K and 114K/day (vs 130K and 92K LLY) at 47–49% markdown.
missed: Singles LY: 11.11 63K/day vs 126K LLY (−50%) and Pre Singles −57%, at slightly lower markdown (33–37% vs 40–43%) and weaker conversion.
October: PD and MS were −48% and −41% vs LLY.
BF Week: 28K/day vs 65K LLY even with impressions +168% (UCR 1.9% vs 2.4%).
do: Rebuild the LLY Singles plan: 40%+ across Pre Singles, 11.11 and Post Singles, with visibility from Pre Singles day 1.
Have the BF Week offer live from the first day (LLY 40% all week).

worked: YF → YF Post was LY's best stretch: 96K and 92K/day (YF Post +44% vs LLY) at 31–39% markdown, with UCR 5.7–6.5%.
LLY Singles at only 24% markdown: 54K / 75K / 46K per day, driven by impressions (+165% to +631% vs Sept).
missed: Singles LY was about half of LLY (11.11 38K vs 75K/day). Impressions were the gap: +119% LY vs +631% LLY at a similar 20–24% markdown.
BF Week LY: 43% markdown but 25.5K/day vs 49K LLY.
Dec (2% markdown) fell −51% vs Sept. Sept 2026 is 10.3K/day vs 20K LY, with UCR 1.98% vs 3.34%.
do: Ask onsite for LLY-level Singles visibility; markdown of about 24% was enough.
Extend the YF offer through YF Post and Ext; check why Sept 2026 conversion dropped.

worked: LLY started early: PD 33K/day (+179% vs Sept) at 30% markdown, then 45–48% for Singles (75K Pre Singles, 61K 11.11).
LY's December was better than LLY's (MS 18K vs 12K/day).
missed: October LY at 4–5% markdown: PD 15K vs 33K LLY (−55%) and MS −41%.
Singles LY at 33–39% markdown: 39–46K/day vs 61–75K LLY.
YF LY: 62K vs 108K/day (−43%) despite impressions +328%, with UCR 1.8% vs 2.9%. Sept 2026 UCR is 1.05% (1.86% LY).
do: Bring back an early-October promo (about 30% for PD) and 45%+ on Singles.
Conversion is the YF gap: check stock depth of hero shades and sets before buying more impressions.

worked: LLY ran a steady 30–37% markdown from Singles to BF: 11.11 49K/day, Pre YF 88K, YF 135K (+1729% vs Sept).
missed: LY Singles at only 20–24% markdown: 11.11 18K vs 49K/day (−64%).
LY went to 62–65% for BF but YF still reached only 68K vs 135K/day, with UCR 1.9% vs 2.9%. Deeper markdown didn't recover it, so conversion and range are the issue.
Sept 2026: 4.1K/day vs 8.8K LY (−53%), UCR 1.0%.
do: Ask for 30%+ through Singles (LLY level) rather than 60%+ only at BF.
Review range, stock and pricing first; the brand has halved since LLY.

worked: LLY's Singles: Pre Singles 37K and 11.11 50K/day at 52% markdown, with impressions 4–5× Sept.
LY's extension after Singles: the BAU week 24K/day vs 10K LLY at 56% markdown.
missed: Pre Singles LY: 12K vs 37K/day (−66%) at 42% markdown and impressions +157% (vs +425% LLY).
December falls off a cliff in both years once markdown stops (−44% to −59% vs Sept).
Sept 2026: 2.8K/day vs 6.4K LY, UCR 1.83% vs 3.02%.
do: Start the Singles deal 4 days early at 50%+ with visibility, and keep the post-Singles extension.

worked: The brand peaks in early December, not at BF: LLY 7–10 Dec 64K/day at 0% markdown, and LY 4–6 Dec 57K/day at 21%. December is bigger than YF in both years.
missed: LY ran 25% markdown across Oct–Nov (+20pp vs Sept) but GMV/day fell 26% vs Sept. The markdown didn't pay.
Oct–Nov run 50–85% below Sept in both years (Sept itself is strong at 10–14K/day).
do: Don't fund deep Nov markdown. Put the stock (gift sets) and visibility into 1–10 Dec, and keep YF modest.

worked: LY window +33% vs LLY. Deep BF (73–77% markdown) took Pre YF to 21K and YF to 27K/day (vs 14K and 22K LLY), with UCR 5–6%.
LY's PD was stronger: 13K vs 6.5K/day.
missed: Singles LY at 22–25% markdown: 11.11 12.7K vs 15.5K/day LLY at 36%.
YF at 77% markdown gave only +25% vs LLY's 34%. That depth is expensive for the extra GMV.
do: Give Singles more (about 35%, as LLY) and test about 50% instead of 75%+ for YF.

worked: LLY ran 52–57% markdown from Pre Singles to Pre YF with impressions up to 10× Sept: 11.11 41K and YF 58K/day.
missed: LY Singles at 26–31% markdown: Pre Singles 7K vs 24.5K/day (−70%), 11.11 30K vs 41K.
YF LY: 22K vs 58K/day (−63%). Impressions were +333% vs +970% LLY, so visibility was the gap. UCR stays low (about 1.2%).
Sept 2026 UCR is 0.98%.
do: Ask for about 50% from Pre Singles (LLY level) and get YF visibility back to LLY levels.

worked: A new brand in LY that grew organically: window +160% vs Sept at a steady 27–32% markdown, with UCR 4–6%.
YF 31K/day (+729% vs Sept) with impressions +1018%. K-beauty demand plus visibility.
missed: December drops once markdown goes to 0%. Sept 2026 is 2.1K/day vs 3.7K LY (−43%), so momentum has slowed.
do: Hold about 30% across every event and keep visibility high; check why Sept 2026 slowed.

worked: LY Singles: 11.11 29.5K vs 10.6K/day LLY (+178%) at only 20% markdown, with UCR 4.6%.
LLY's BF: 25% markdown with impressions 8–10× Sept gave Pre YF 28.5K and YF 38K/day.
missed: LY BF Week and Pre YF at 44–52% markdown gave 9K and 14K/day, about half of LLY. Impressions were +21–69% vs +780–870% LLY, so visibility, not markdown, was the gap.
December LY at 4–11% markdown fell to 3–5K/day vs 7–15K LLY at 16–20%.
do: Repeat LY's Singles. For BF, ask for impressions rather than more markdown (about 25% was enough LLY), and keep about 20% into December.

worked: YF Post LY: 35K/day vs 31K LLY at 54% markdown. LLY's YF reached 58K/day at 48%.
missed: YF LY: 31K vs 58K/day (−47%) at a similar 45% markdown and similar impressions, so conversion and ASP were the gap.
BF Week LY: 8.7K vs 22K/day even though impressions were +334%.
Sept 2026: 1.7K/day vs 4.9K LY (−66%).
do: Check stock and assortment first: the brand is down two-thirds since LY Sept. Then rebuild the YF offer.

worked: Singles held: 11.11 21K/day in both years at about 52% markdown, and LY's BAU week after Singles reached 10K vs 6K LLY.
missed: BF LY: Pre YF 14K vs 18K/day and YF 19K vs 28K.
BF Ext: LY cut markdown to 0% and fell to 4K vs 12K/day LLY (which kept 48%).
Sept 2026: 1.3K/day vs 3.6K LY.
do: Keep about 48% through BF Ext; dropping it on 2–3 Dec cost about two-thirds of the GMV.

worked: The window winner: LY 378K vs 208K LLY (+81%).
Pre Singles at 47% markdown: 11K vs 5.6K/day.
YF and YF Post 25K/day each (vs 10K and 6K LLY) at 38–41%, with impressions 6× Sept.
missed: PD and MS LY at 8–13% markdown were flat vs LLY.
do: Repeat the LY plan; Sept 2026 is up 21% vs LY Sept, so the brand is growing. Add an October hook.

worked: LY window +34% vs LLY. Deep Singles (57–67% markdown) extended into the following week: Post Singles 13K vs 6K/day and the BAU week 15.6K vs 2.5K.
missed: YF LY: 9.9K vs 13.4K/day (−26%) at 46% markdown even with impressions +302%. UCR 4.1% vs 5.0%.
December drops 52–62% once markdown ends. Sept 2026: 2.0K/day vs 3.5K LY.
do: Repeat the extended Singles; find a stronger YF hero offer rather than more impressions.

worked: Singles was strong in both years: 11.11 24K/day at 33–42% markdown.
LLY's PD: 12K/day (+128% vs Sept).
missed: BF collapsed in LY: Week 7K vs 20K/day, Pre YF 9K vs 22K, YF 13K vs 39K (−66%). That happened at 46–63% markdown and impressions +306%; UCR on YF was 2.3% vs 4.8%.
Sept 2026: 3.2K/day vs 5.3K LY, UCR 1.40%.
do: Markdown depth wasn't the problem. Check stock of hero sets for BF and the offer mechanics before OND.

worked: 11.11 LY: 21K vs 14K/day LLY (+44%) at 27% markdown.
LLY's BF: YF 28K/day at 28%.
missed: LY Sept carried 29.5% markdown, then October dropped to 1–3%, so PD and MS fell to 2.6–4K/day (−37% to −61% vs Sept).
YF LY: 24K vs 28K/day at 32%.
do: Avoid a promo gap between September and October; repeat the 11.11 offer and lift YF visibility.

worked: The fastest grower: LY +45% vs LLY from a small Sept base, with best-in-class conversion (UCR 8–12% on event days).
YF Post LY: 22K/day at 49% markdown.
missed: Visibility lagged demand: impressions rose less than GMV on most days, and December drops once markdown ends.
do: Sept 2026 is 3.1K/day (3.6× LY Sept). Give it more impressions; it converts them better than almost anyone.

worked: YF Post LY: 23K vs 12K/day (+92%) at 54% markdown.
Singles in both years: 11.11 15–17K/day at 40–41%.
missed: YF LY: 17K vs 30K/day. Impressions were +133% vs +1057% LLY, so visibility was the gap.
BF Week LY: 6.8K vs 13K/day.
Sept 2026: 1.1K/day vs 3.7K LY (−71%).
do: Check stock and listings first (Sept 2026 is down 71%), then ask for LLY-level YF visibility.
